all.source_quote: Must be 18 years or above at the time of registration

unmodelled.text: Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in a notified traditional trade
unmodelled.source_quote: Artisan/Craftsperson requirement: Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the notified traditional trades

unmodelled.text: Applicant should be self‑employed in the unorganised sector
unmodelled.source_quote: Type of work: Should be self‑employed in the unorganised sector

unmodelled.text: Must be actively engaged in one of the 18 specified family‑based traditional trades
unmodelled.source_quote: Trade condition: Must be actively engaged in one of the 18 specified family‑based traditional trades

unmodelled.text: Applicant should not have availed similar government self‑employment loans in the last 5 years
unmodelled.source_quote: Loan condition: Should not have availed similar government self‑employment loans (e.g., PMEGP, Mudra, SVANidhi) in the last 5 years

unmodelled.text: Only one member per family is eligible
unmodelled.source_quote: Family restriction: Only one member per family is eligible to avail benefits under the scheme

unmodelled.text: Government employees and their family members are excluded
unmodelled.source_quote: Exclusion: Government employees and their family members are not eligible

unmodelled.text: List of traditional trades (e.g., Carpenter, Boat maker, etc.) is required but cannot be expressed with available fields
unmodelled.source_quote: List of Traditional Trades: Carpenter, Boat maker, Armourer, Black smith, Hammer and Toolkit maker, Lock smith, Sculpture, Gold smith, potter, cobbler, Masions, Basket/Mat/Broom maker/Coir waiver, Doll and Toy maker, Barber, Garland maker, Washerman, Toiler, Fishing Net maker
